metrics_avalanche_vw.query:
SELECT event_category,
       event_subcategory,
       metric_name,
       metric_value,
       metric_unit,
       file_date,
       is_predicted
FROM geo.metrics_observed_vw
WHERE event_category = 'avalanche'
UNION ALL
SELECT event_category,
       NULL::text AS event_subcategory,
       metric_name,
       predicted_value AS metric_value,
       metric_unit,
       file_date::timestamp AS file_date,
       is_predicted
FROM geo.prediction_etl
WHERE event_category = 'avalanche'

phenomenons_us_vw.query: SELECT initcap(event_category) AS event_category, initcap(event_subcategory) AS event_subcategory, COALESCE(event_name, initcap(event_category)) || CASE WHEN event_description IS NOT NULL THEN E':\n\n' || event_description ELSE '' END AS event_ndesc, latitude, longitude, country_code, state_province, place_location, danger_rating, metric_name, metric_value, metric_unit, (SELECT string_agg(e.key || ': ' || (e.value #>> '{}') || CASE WHEN NULLIF(a.other_metrics, '')::jsonb ->> (e.key || '_unit') IS NOT NULL THEN ' (' || (NULLIF(a.other_metrics, '')::jsonb ->> (e.key || '_unit')) || ')' ELSE '' END, '; ' ORDER BY e.key) FROM jsonb_each(NULLIF(a.other_metrics, '')::jsonb) AS e(key, value) WHERE e.key NOT LIKE '%\_unit') AS other_metrics, COALESCE(event_start, file_date::timestamp) AS event_start_date, event_end AS event_end_date FROM geo.union_etl AS a WHERE country_code = 'US'

phenomenons_waters_vw.query: SELECT initcap(event_category) AS event_category, initcap(event_subcategory) AS event_subcategory, COALESCE(event_name, initcap(event_category)) || CASE WHEN event_description IS NOT NULL THEN E':\n\n' || event_description ELSE '' END AS event_ndesc, latitude, longitude, country_code, state_province, place_location, danger_rating, metric_name, metric_value, metric_unit, (SELECT string_agg(e.key || ': ' || (e.value #>> '{}') || CASE WHEN NULLIF(a.other_metrics, '')::jsonb ->> (e.key || '_unit') IS NOT NULL THEN ' (' || (NULLIF(a.other_metrics, '')::jsonb ->> (e.key || '_unit')) || ')' ELSE '' END, '; ' ORDER BY e.key) FROM jsonb_each(NULLIF(a.other_metrics, '')::jsonb) AS e(key, value) WHERE e.key NOT LIKE '%\_unit') AS other_metrics, COALESCE(event_start, file_date::timestamp) AS event_start_date, event_end AS event_end_date FROM geo.union_etl AS a WHERE latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL AND (country_code = 'ZZ' OR country_code = 'AQ' OR event_subcategory = 'sea_lake_ice' OR (coalesce(event_name, '') || ' ' || coalesce(place_location, '') || ' ' || coalesce(event_description, '')) ~* '\y(ocean|sea|gulf|strait|offshore|coast)\y|off the coast|open water')

metrics_observed_vw.query:
WITH observed AS (
    SELECT event_category,
           event_subcategory,
           file_date::timestamp AS file_date,
           metric_name,
           metric_value,
           metric_unit,
           other_metrics
    FROM geo.union_etl
    WHERE event_category IN ('avalanche', 'drought', 'earthquake', 'fire', 'flood', 'iceberg', 'storm', 'volcano')
),
own_metric AS (
    SELECT event_category,
           event_subcategory,
           metric_name,
           metric_value,
           metric_unit,
           file_date
    FROM observed
    WHERE metric_value IS NOT NULL
      AND (event_category <> 'earthquake' OR metric_unit NOT IN ('mh', 'Mi', 'mun', 'ms_vx'))
      AND (event_category <> 'flood' OR metric_name IN ('discharge', 'threshold', 'baseline_days', 'exceedance_ratio', 'magnitude'))
),
other_metric AS (
    SELECT a.event_category,
           a.event_subcategory,
           e.key AS metric_name,
           (e.value #>> '{}')::double precision AS metric_value,
           a.other_metrics::jsonb ->> (e.key || '_unit') AS metric_unit,
           a.file_date
    FROM observed a
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(NULLIF(a.other_metrics, '')::jsonb) AS e(key, value)
    WHERE e.key NOT LIKE '%\_unit'
      AND jsonb_typeof(e.value) = 'number'
)
SELECT event_category,
       event_subcategory,
       metric_name,
       metric_value,
       metric_unit,
       file_date,
       FALSE AS is_predicted
FROM own_metric
UNION ALL
SELECT event_category,
       event_subcategory,
       metric_name,
       metric_value,
       metric_unit,
       file_date,
       FALSE AS is_predicted
FROM other_metric
WHERE (event_category <> 'earthquake' OR metric_unit NOT IN ('mh', 'Mi', 'mun', 'ms_vx'))
  AND (event_category <> 'flood' OR metric_name IN ('discharge', 'threshold', 'baseline_days', 'exceedance_ratio', 'magnitude'))
